propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES to {'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'} whereas DC reads from ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses config, causing Cloud tenants with non-standard workflow status names to misclassify issues as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED.

JiraConfig must expose resolved_statuses as a configurable list[str] defaulting to ['Resolved','Done','Cancelled'], coerced via _as_str_list from [tool.rebar.jira] with REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.

Cloud probe classify_probe_response must resolve the status set from loaded config at classification time, falling back to module-level default when config is unset, empty, or raises ConfigError, mirroring DC's settings.py guard.

A tenant configuring custom jira.resolved_statuses=['Closed','Complete'] must classify 'Closed' issues as PRESENT_RESOLVED and 'Done' issues as PRESENT_FILTERED, proving the configured set overrides rather than merges with defaults.
